attempted_claim: Let b>=2 be an integer and a an integer of the same parity as b with a>=b+1+2*sqrt(b) (in particular b=2, a even, a>=6). For every N>=1 prove c^N_{b,ell}(a) >= 2a/(a+b-1), where c^N_{b,ell}(a)=inf{lambda>0 | E(1,a)xC^N symplectically embeds into lambda*E(1,b)xC^N}, hence with Hind folding c^N_{b,ell}(a)=2a/(a+b-1); in particular E(1,a)xC^N into lambda*E(1,2)xC^N implies lambda>=2a/(a+1) for all even a>=6 and N>=1.
decisive_failure: The investigation could not bridge the stabilization gap: single higher capacities provably miss the same-parity bound and ECH counts lack a transfer theorem to N>=1. The infinite same-parity stabilized range remains open and conditional on unfinished SFT foundations; no emergent finding is claimed.
